user.title: Docker Socket Proxy
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Docker Proxy. For an HTTPS proxy that uses a private CA or requires client certificates (mutual TLS), upload the files below; leave them empty otherwise.

data_description.ca_cert: PEM file used to verify the proxy's certificate. Only needed if the proxy uses a private or self-signed CA. Defaults to the system trust store.
data_description.client_cert: PEM client certificate, for proxies that require mutual TLS. Must be provided together with the private key.
data_description.client_key: PEM private key matching the client certificate. Stored in the config entry like other credentials.
data_description.client_key_password: Only needed if the private key is encrypted.
data_description.url: Address of the Docker socket proxy: http or https, host name or IP address, and port (for example 192.168.1.100:2375). Use https for a TLS-protected proxy.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Docker Socket Proxy
reconfigure.description: Change the proxy URL or TLS files. Existing entities and history are kept. Currently stored: {stored}. Leave a file field empty to keep the stored file.

data_description.client_key: PEM private key matching the client certificate. Stored in the config entry like other credentials.
data_description.client_key_password: Only needed if the private key is encrypted.
data_description.clear_tls: Deletes the CA certificate, client certificate and key from this entry. Upload new files above to replace them instead.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Docker Proxy, check the URL
error.ssl_error: TLS handshake failed. Check that the CA certificate trusts the proxy and that the URL host name matches the proxy certificate.
error.invalid_ca_cert: The CA certificate is not a valid PEM certificate
error.invalid_client_cert: The client certificate is not a valid PEM certificate
error.invalid_client_key: The client private key is not a valid PEM key
error.client_cert_key_required: Provide both the client certificate and the client private key, or neither
error.client_cert_key_mismatch: The client certificate and private key do not belong together
error.client_key_password_required: The private key is encrypted; enter its passphrase
error.client_key_password_incorrect: The private key passphrase is incorrect
